text:
Some electrical devices require a magnet which may be switched on and off many times in a
second.
Which type of magnet may be used?
A
an electromagnet only
B
a permanent magnet only
C
either a permanent magnet or an electromagnet
D
neither a permanent magnet nor an electromagnet

options.label: C
options.text: either a permanent magnet or an electromagnet

options.label: D
options.text: neither a permanent magnet nor an electromagnet
